title: Batgirl #25
desc:
BATGIRL CELEBRATES A 25-ISSUE MILESTONE!

Happy birthday, Batgirl!

Well, it isn't exactly our favorite brooding girl's birthday, but it is the 25th issue of her ongoing series, so we're celebrating with an oversize issue! It would sure be a shame if anything spoiled the celebrations like, say, the long-awaited return of...David Cain?!

Uh-oh, blow out the candles, Cass—things are about to get messy.

Not to mention, Damion Scott, the co-creator of our special girl, returns to the character for a special backup! You don't want to miss this!
